image_description: A white disposable diaper lying flat on a textured, striped fabric surface (red, green, and beige stripes). The diaper is oriented with the front panel facing up. It features elasticized leg cuffs with visible ruffles/gathering on both sides. Adhesive fastening tabs are visible on the side panels. The outer surface appears smooth and white. No distinct wetness strip or size indicators are clearly legible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular when flat, with elasticized leg openings and waistband.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object has the characteristic hourglass/rectangular shape of a diaper with clear elasticized leg openings and a defined waistband area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thickness is notably padded and bulky when uncompressed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The diaper shows significant volume and puffiness in the central absorbent core area, consistent with a padded garment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Folded form shows layered construction with absorbent core between layers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The diaper is laid flat/open, not folded in a way that exposes the internal cross-section or layered construction of the core.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Fastening system uses adhesive tabs (hook-and-loop or sticky) on side panels.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct adhesive tabs are visible on the left and right side panels of the diaper's front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elastic creates gathered ruffles at leg cuffs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Clear gathering/ruffling is visible along the inner edges of the leg holes, indicating elastic tension.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Size indicators and wetness strip may be visible.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No specific size numbers or colored wetness indicator lines are discernible on the visible white surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Outer surface is smooth plastic or fabric-like material in white or printed patterns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface appears smooth and white, consistent with the non-woven/plastic outer layer of a disposable diaper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Inner surface is soft non-woven fabric.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The inner surface (which touches the skin) is facing down against the background and is not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Absorbent padded core with waterproof outer layer.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Inferred from the bulkiness (core) and smooth texture (waterproof layer), which aligns with the visual appearance of a standard disposable diaper.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a diaper and distinguish it from similar cloth items like underwear or pads.
To verify the integrity of the elastic ruffles and ensure no melting/fusion artifacts at the complex boundaries of the leg cuffs.
To check for subtle texture inconsistencies in the smooth plastic surface and the striped background fabric.
To ensure the diaper sits correctly on the fabric background without floating or shadow errors.

focus_areas: Elastic ruffle consistency at leg openings
Contact shadows between diaper and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the elastic ruffles; AI often struggles with the repetitive, fine-grained geometry of gathered fabric. Ensure the adhesive tabs look physically attached and not just painted on. Verify the background stripes remain straight and consistent behind/around the diaper to rule out perspective warping.
